Term Dates 2025/26

Below are the published term dates and INSET days for the 2025/26 academic year.

Autumn Term 2025

  • INSET Day (school closed to pupils): Monday 1 September 2025
  • First day for students: Tuesday 2 September 2025
  • Half Term holiday: Monday 27 October 2025 to Friday 31 October 2025
  • Term ends: Friday 19 December 2025

Spring Term 2026

  • Term begins: Monday 5 January 2026
  • INSET Day: Friday 13 February 2026
  • Half Term: Monday 16 February 2026 to Friday 20 February 2026
  • Term ends: Friday 27 March 2026

Summer Term 2026

  • Term begins: Monday 13 April 2026
  • Half Term: Monday 25 May 2026 to Friday 29 May 2026
  • INSET Day: Monday 6 July 2026
  • Last day for students: Friday 24 July 2026
  • Professional Development Day: Monday 27 July 2026
